entries.declaration: function buyExactIn(address curve, address payAsset, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minStockOut, uint256 minTokensOut, address recipient, address referrer, (address,uint16) fee) payable returns (uint256 tokensOut)
entries.explanation: Document router buy inputs, protection minima, recipients, referral and integrator fee tuple; returned tokens are not a read-only cost/refund quote.
entries.units: Addresses identify roles/assets; booleans are flags; IDs/counts are integers, not amounts. Nested currency/token/stock fields are addresses. An ordinary PoolKey fee uses hundredths of one basis point (1000000 = 100%); dynamic-fee flag/sentinel values are not numeric fee rates; tickSpacing is signed ticks. Trading-rate BPS use 10000 = 100%; creator-buy/drop caps concern supply and trading fees concern pair-asset-side amounts. creatorShareOfBaseBps concerns a share of the base fee, not trade value, but its raw denominator is not established by its name or this ABI: do not automatically divide it by 10000 or equate it to a published percentage. Confirm source arithmetic or publisher use before scaling fee-share and other undocumented ratio fields. Raw token/pair/native-value units remain distinct; authenticate asset decimals. Time fields are seconds; byte/gas bounds are not fees. sqrtPriceRunWad is a publisher WAD-labelled curve input, not a live market price; do not infer deployed arithmetic or gross/net ordering.
